faqs.question: How do I request a refund?
faqs.answer: You can request a full refund within 24 hours of booking confirmation through your dashboard under Payments > Request Refund, or by submitting a ticket under Help & Support.

faqs.question: How long does refund processing take?
faqs.answer: Refunds are escrow-protected by ZILHAJ and processed directly back to your original payment method (Bank/UPI/Card) within 5 to 7 business days.

faqs.question: How can I track my refund status?
faqs.answer: You can check real-time refund status on the Payments tab or view resolution notes under My Support Requests.

faqs.question: How far are the partner hotels from the Haram in Makkah and Madinah?
faqs.answer: Hotels are categorised by distance: 5-Star luxury options are within 50–150 meters (walking distance); 3-Star economy options (500–900m) include complimentary 24/7 electric AC shuttle transfers.

faqs.question: How does the Umrah & Hajj visa process work?
faqs.answer: Once your agency offer is confirmed, ZILHAJ verified travel agencies submit your passport scans directly to the official Saudi Nusuk / eVisa portal. The approved eVisa is issued within 48 to 72 hours.

faqs.question: Can I change my preferred travel departure date?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can request a departure date amendment up to 14 days before scheduled travel by raising a support request with category "Travel Date Change".

faqs.question: Are historical Ziyarat tours included in packages?
faqs.answer: Most standard and deluxe packages include guided Ziyarat in Makkah (Ghar Hira, Mina, Muzdalifah, Arafat) and Madinah (Masjid Quba, Mount Uhud, Masjid Qiblatayn) in luxury air-conditioned coaches.
